subject: PO matching window, filename conventions, and email fallback for invoices
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Acme Payments Billing <billing@acmepay.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 30 Aug 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: PO matching window, filename conventions, and email fallback for invoices

Hi Liam / Acme billing team,

Quick clarification as we're finishing vendor setup for Acme Payments — two questions so our AP system (and vendor portal) can process your invoices without manual intervention: 

1) PO matching window: What is your expected invoice submission window relative to the PO date that you consider "matched"? For example, do you accept invoices up to 45 days after the PO date, or do you require invoice date <= PO date + 30 days? Our cashflow team needs this to set automatic PO-match acceptance rules.

2) Filename and subject-line convention for email fallbacks: For vendors that email invoices instead of using the portal, we require a consistent subject token and filename pattern for automated ingestion. Our preference is: Subject contains "PO#<po-number>" and filenames adopted as "PO<po>-YYYYMMDD-<supplier>.pdf" (e.g., PO12345-20250829-Acme.pdf). Do you have an existing standard you prefer? If you can follow the pattern above it will reduce handoffs.

Attached is a short PDF with the filename examples and the exception form we use when a PO-match fails. If you prefer a different pattern, please send a couple of samples and we can map them to our pipeline.

Would appreciate confirmation by Tuesday so we can finish onboarding.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Partner Ops (Vendor Onboarding)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sample-invoice-filename-guidelines.pdf (1 page), po-matching-exception-form.docx (form)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@acmepay.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Acme Payments Billing <billing@acmepay.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Sep 2025 10:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: PO matching window, filename conventions, and email fallback for invoices

Hi Rachel — thanks for the clear note. A couple quick answers: 

1) PO matching window: Standard policy is invoice date up to 60 days after PO date. We can accept later dates but they require manual review and may delay payment. If Redwood's system needs a tighter automatic threshold (30 or 45 days) we can try to tighten our submission process on our side to comply.

2) Filename / subject: We can adopt the subject token requirement (include "PO#12345" in the subject) for emailed invoices. Our billing system currently emits files named like "ACME_INV_20250829_PO12345.pdf". We can switch to your preferred pattern; it would take one billing-cycle to roll out the change. In the interim, we can provide a mapping map (we'll add three sample filenames in the next message).

One more note — when emailing billing, please CC billing@acmepay.com and include the PO number in both subject and first line of the message body; that helps our parser when attachments are zipped.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Vendor Billing
Acme Payments

Date: Mon, 1 Sep 2025 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO matching window, filename conventions, and email fallback for invoices

Thanks Liam — that's helpful. A couple of follow-ups so our AP rules are precise: 

• We'll set the automatic PO-match window to 45 days. Invoices dated 46–60 days will route to "requires review" and will be manually approved by Monica's team. Can you commit to aiming for <=45 days where possible?

• Mapping plan while you rollout filename change: please send the three representative filenames (as promised) and we'll add a quick regex map so files like "ACME_INV_20250829_PO12345.pdf" are accepted by the ingestion pipeline for the next 30 days. After that we'll flip to strict enforcement of the new pattern.

• Email fallback conventions: Subject must contain PO# (no spaces between PO and number is fine) and include a one-line body that starts with the PO#. Example subject: "Invoice PO#12345 - August services"; first line of body: "PO#12345". If invoices arrive without the token we'll place them into a manual queue.

Action items: 
- Liam: reply with the three sample filenames by EOD tomorrow (Tue 2 Sep).
- Monica: once Liam confirms, can you set the matcher to 45 days auto-accept and send the exception routing steps to the vendor?
- Vanessa: I'll loop you for onboarding checklist update (filename guidance + exception form).

Thanks — Rachel

All — quick update after talking to Ops:

- Monica, please set the AP matcher to auto-accept invoices where invoice_date <= PO_date + 45 days. Anything 46–60 days routes to "billing-review" queue. Over 60 days will auto-reject with the vendor-facing exception form (attached).

- Liam, the filename mapping plan works. Please send the three sample filenames now so we can add the temporary regex map for 30 days. After 30 days we'll switch to strict filename enforcement and email-token-only acceptance will be used as a fallback for rare edge cases (zipped files, partner EDI flows).

- Karthik, the onboarding checklist will be updated in Confluence under Vendor Onboarding -> Acme Payments with the filename examples, the subject token requirement, and the exception form link. I'll add the sample templates and an example subject/body snippet the vendor can copy.

Liam — small request: when you send the sample files, please include one zipped invoice example and one invoice with multiple pages so we can validate parser behavior.

Thanks, everyone. Rachel — once you confirm receipt from Liam, I'll mark this vendor onboarding step as "complete" in the activation tracker.

Vanessa Ortiz
Vendor Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
